committed: before js/kernels/interiors/, the validation tool, the oracle's results and the tests existed

classes.note: conventions, not measurements: density cannot tell hydrogen and helium from water ice (Jupiter and Uranus differ by 4 percent), so the third class is not split; a body whose density lies within 2 sigma of a boundary is labelled ambiguous

anchors.source: NASA Planetary Fact Sheets (NSSDCA), typed, unchecked; the fact sheet's gravity and escape speed use the equatorial radius, its density the volumetric mean

checks.bound: bulk density, surface gravity, escape speed and their first-order uncertainties against an independent numpy evaluation on 1,000 seeded (GM, R, sigmas) points: values to 1e-12, uncertainties to 1e-10, relative
the nine bodies against the fact sheet: density within 1 percent, gravity (equatorial radius) within 1 percent, escape speed within 2 percent (the fact sheet rounds it to two figures)
the volumetric mean radius (a^2 b)^(1/3) from the equatorial and polar radii within 0.1 percent of the tabulated mean for Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune

the equilibrium temperature of Mercury, the Moon and Saturn (Bond albedo, semi-major axis, full redistribution) within 2 percent of the fact sheet's black-body temperatures; for the six bodies of the Prompt 200 pack the value equals Prompt 200's own to 1e-12 (one source of truth)

Mercury, Venus, Earth, the Moon and Mars classify rocky; Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune volatile-rich; Jupiter and Uranus are reported as indistinguishable by density (within 5 percent); a body within 2 sigma of a boundary is labelled ambiguous
the first-order uncertainty of density, gravity and escape speed against the standard deviation of 200,000 numpy Monte Carlo draws of (GM, R, G) for each of the nine bodies: within 2 percent

the compression correction (bulk minus uncompressed density) and its uncertainty (the table's declared 0.2 g/cm3 combined with the bulk density's) against the oracle to 1e-12; for the five bodies of the table the bulk density exceeds the uncompressed one

seeded ensemble of 4,000 trials per body: truth drawn from the table's stated errors, an 'observed' table drawn around it, the quantity computed from the observed table; the stated 1-sigma interval covers the quantity computed from the truth at a rate in [0.64, 0.72] and the 2-sigma interval in [0.94, 0.97], for density, gravity and escape speed of all nine bodies

at least 24 hostile inputs (zero, negative, non-finite and string masses and radii, negative sigmas, a sigma above the value, unknown bodies, unknown radius kinds, an empty selection) each refused with a named code and no number
